topPRs.title: lagoon: specify post-exec receipt JSON-RPC fee fields
topPRs.author: geoknee
topPRs.body:
## Why

Closes part of [protocol-team#333](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/protocol-team/issues/333) (DoD items 1 and 2).

The post-exec (`0x7D`) § Receipt section pinned only the **consensus** RLP fields. The OP-specific fee fields a client surfaces over JSON-RPC were left unspecified, so op-reth derives `l1Fee` and `l1GasUsed` from the post-exec transaction's encoding like any other non-deposit transaction. On sdm-net-0 a fee-less transaction therefore reports a non-zero L1 fee:

```jsonc
{
  "type": "0x7d",
  "gasUsed": "0x0",
  "effectiveGasPrice": "0x0",
  "l1Fee": "0x1ae917a28",   // <- fee-less tx, non-zero fee
  "l1GasUsed": "0x640"
}
```

That is misleading for explorers, indexers and fee accounting that sum L1 fees across a block's receipts.

## What

§ Receipt is split into **Consensus Fields** (unchanged text) and a new **JSON-RPC Fields** subsection, which specifies the fee fields in the two groups they naturally fall into:

- **Transaction-scoped** — what *this* transaction was charged. A post-exec transaction is charged nothing, so `gasUsed`, `effectiveGasPrice`, `l1Fee`, `l1GasUsed` and `blobGasUsed` MUST each be present and zero. `cumulativeGasUsed` is called out separately since it is block-cumulative and inherits the preceding receipt's value. `opGasRefund` MUST be absent or `null`.
- **Block-scoped** — the block's L1 fee parameters, read from the L1 attributes deposit. `l1GasPrice`, `l1BaseFeeScalar`, `l1BlobBaseFee`, `l1BlobBaseFeeScalar`, `operatorFeeScalar`, `operatorFeeConstant` and `daFootprintGasScalar` MUST match every other receipt in the same block in both value and presence. `l1FeeScalar` is pre-Ecotone only, so a post-exec receipt never reports it.

## Zeroed, not omitted

The issue raised omitting `l1Fee`/`l1GasUsed` instead, on the grounds that deposit (`0x7E`) receipts omit them. That precedent only holds for op-geth: `deriveOPStackFields` skips deposits entirely, so the fields are `nil` and drop out of the JSON. op-reth does **not** — a `0x7E` receipt on sdm-net-0 reports `l1Fee: "0x0"` and a *non-zero* `l1GasUsed: "0x738"`, since only `l1_tx_data_fee` takes the `is_deposit` flag and `l1_data_gas` does not.

So there is no single existing deposit shape to follow. This spec zeroes instead, which:

- keeps a post-exec receipt the same shape as a regular transaction's receipt;
- matches `gasUsed` and `effectiveGasPrice`, already present-and-zero on these receipts;
- lets a consumer sum `l1Fee` over a block's receipts and reach the right total with no special case and no key-existence check.

`l1GasUsed: 0` is also consistent with [§ DA Footprint](https://specs.optimism.io/protocol/lagoon/post-exec.html#da-footprint), which already requires clients to treat a post-exec transaction's DA footprint as zero and its `blobGasUsed` as zero.

## Notes

- The block-scoped half is already the observed behaviour on sdm-net-0 — every one of those fields matches the regular receipts in the same block, and `blobGasUsed` is already `0x0`. Specifying it locks that in rather than changing it.
- A deposit receipt's `l1Fee`/`l1GasUsed` shape still differs between op-geth (omitted) and op-reth (present, and `l1GasUsed` non-zero). That is pre-existing and out of scope here, but worth its own ticket.

Implementation: ethereum-optimism/optimism#22941 (op-reth).
